items.title: 364 bodies recovered in Chitwan after Bhotekoshi floods, 14 identified
items.summary: Chitwan, September 16 A total of 364 bodies have been recovered in Chitwan following the floods in the Bhotekoshi River in Rasuwa, with 14 of them identified so far. DNA samples have been collected from 81 relatives of people who remain missing to assist in the identification process. items.title: Expert panel formed to scientifically study Rasuwa Flood
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 16 The government has formed a seven-member expert committee to scientifically investigate the causes and sequence of events behind the devastating flood in the Bhotekoshi River in Rasuwa.
